proposals.title: Nightly sweep: 1604 sites in 122 countries, Nov 2 to Nov 8
proposals.summary:
Our nightly sweep reviewed 1604 public websites in 122 countries last week (Nov 2 to Nov 8).

What came up most often among each site's top issues:
• Text with too little color contrast: 64% of sites
• No HSTS header: 54% of sites
• Form fields without a label: 47% of sites

Most of these are small fixes. See one full case and its fix in our sample report:
https://carlosandmunoz.com/qa-review.html?sample=1&week=2026-11-09

Ran a review already? Your report reopens free for 7 days.
